title: Secret Relationship Request
scenario: An online contact asks you to hide the relationship from parents and friends.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Secret Relationship Request: the trap is to turn familiarity or emotion into compliance. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Secrecy pressure is a safety warning.
